Let's Eat With Kibwe

$150–$250

Nashville private-chef and wedding catering service led by Chef Lorna Boyd. Wedding services list a plated dinner and a buffet-style dinner, each with a published starting rate.

Plated includes a three-course meal and waitstaff with a 20-guest minimum. Buffet includes two entrees, two sides, salad, and bread with a 30-guest minimum. Travel outside Nashville is listed at an added $450. No street address is on the pages opened. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
